verdict.rationale: Admin-enforced sign-in security is a fair question for a business password manager, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about push-based sign-in, number matching, location context, or admin-enforced MFA policies. Passkey support, one-time password storage and system-authentication CLI sign-in are related features but not this capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, push-based sign-in includes phishing defenses — number matching, location context, and admin-enforced MFA policies
